iPhone 18 Pro is just weeks away from launch, and rumors suggest it could bring a host of camera upgrades worth paying attention to. Here are the three main camera features currently circulating.

iPhone 18 Pro camera rumors focus on three upgrades

Every year, Apple finds a different way to improve the iPhone's camera. Last year, the iPhone 17's highlight was the all-new Center Stage front camera, while the iPhone 17 Pro featured a significantly improved telephoto lens.

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports that the iPhone 18 Pro will bring "the biggest jump in camera hardware in years."

Current rumors point to three main upgrades:

  • Main camera with variable aperture
  • Larger telephoto aperture
  • Pro-oriented software features

Depending on the actual design details, a variable aperture could be the most eye-catching new feature. This camera feature has been rumored for years, but how Apple ultimately integrates it into the user experience remains unclear.

For example, it could allow users to manually adjust focus and depth of field for each photo, opening up more creative possibilities; it could also enhance portrait mode, low-light shooting performance, and adaptability across different scenarios—or even all of the above.

A larger telephoto aperture means better performance in low-light environments, which is precisely the current weakness of that lens.

Details on the new software features are not yet available, but here is a report by Aaron Tilley for The Information earlier:

Apple's upcoming iPhone 18 Pro models will begin to rival professional-grade cameras in some advanced features. As a result, the company is planning upgrades to the built-in camera app on its smartphones, according to people familiar with the matter. The current iPhone camera app offers mostly basic controls.

Apple last year exclusively introduced the Dual Capture video recording software feature on its newest iPhones. It looks like some Pro-exclusive software features may be added this year.

Beyond these changes, rumors suggest the Camera Control button will also be redesigned this year.

What are your expectations for the iPhone 18 Pro's camera? Let us know in the comments section.
